trainer.dialogueBefore: Worker Dillan: Mind the moving floor! It'll carry you off before you know it. A battle, though? Now that I can do!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Worker Dillan: Knocked flat. I'll blame the floor for that one.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Worker Holden: Hot work in here. Let's see if your Pokémon can stand the heat!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Worker Holden: Phew. I think I need to cool off.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Worker Conrad: Iron's forged in fire, and so are Pokémon. Come on, then!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Worker Conrad: Still a bit soft, my team. Back in the furnace with us.
